title: Enamel-Gene Relics in Birds and Turtles — Reproducible Comparative Genomics Pipeline and Preprint Package
description: Audited comparative genomics and paleogenomics pipeline, supplementary tables (Table S0-S9), publication figures (Figures 1-3), provenance logs, and bioRxiv manuscript package for: 'Unannotated Enamel-Gene Relics on the Avian Z Chromosome, Disordered-Protein Homology Bias, and Phylogenetic Limits of Inactivating-Mutation Dating in Birds and Turtles'.
notes: Independent computational research; no external funding or institutional endorsement. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24358066.
